entries.title: Jeremiah 48:1
segments: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, against Moab: Woe to Nebo, for it is ravaged! Kiriathaim [is] shamed [and] captured. The Fortress is shamed and razed.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:2
segments: [There shall be] no more praise of Moab. In Heshbon they have plotted evil against it, saying, Come and let us cut it off [from being] a nation. Also you shall be silenced, O madmen; the sword shall pursue you.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:3
segments: A voice of crying [shall be] heard from Horonaim, plundering and great ruin.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:4
segments: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:5
segments: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of ruin.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:6
segments: Flee, save your lives, and be like a naked thing in the wilderness.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:7
segments: For because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you shall also be captured. And Chemosh shall go into exile [with] his priests and his rulers.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:8
segments: And the robber shall come on every city, and no city shall escape. Also the valley shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the LORD has spoken.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:9
segments: Give wings to Moab so that it may flee and get away; for its cities shall be a desert, without an inhabitant in them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:10
segments: Cursed [is] he who does the work of the LORD deceitfully, and cursed [is] he who keeps back his sword from blood.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:11
segments: Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his lees and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, nor has he gone into exile. Therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:12
segments: Therefore behold, the days come, says the LORD, that I will send pourers to him, who shall pour him off, and his vessels shall empty, and shatter their jars.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:13
segments: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their hope.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:14
segments: How do you say, We [are] mighty and strong men for war?

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:15
segments: Moab is plundered and has come up out of her cities. And his chosen young men have gone down to the slaughter, says the King whose name [is] the LORD of hosts.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:16
segments: The calamity of Moab [is] near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:17
segments: All you who are around him, mourn him. And all you who know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, [and] the beautiful rod!

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:18
segments: O dweller, daughter of Dibon, come down from [your] glory and sit in thirst. For the ravager of Moab shall come on you; he shall destroy your strongholds.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:19
segments: O dweller of Aroer, stand by the way and watch. Ask him who flees and her who escapes; say, What is happening?

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:20
segments: Moab is put to shame, for it is broken down. Howl and cry! Tell it in Arnon that Moab is stripped.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:21
segments: And judgment has come on the plain country; on Holon, and on Jahazah, and on Mephaath,

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:22
segments: and on Dibon, and on Nebo, and on Beth-diblathaim,

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:23
segments: and on Kiriathaim, and on Beth-gamul, and on Beth-meon,

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:24
segments: and on Kerioth, and on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:25
segments: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:26
segments: Make him drunk, for he magnified [himself] against the LORD. Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be a mockery.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:27
segments: For was not Israel a mockery to you? Was he found among thieves? For ever since you spoke of him, you skipped for joy.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:28
segments: O you who dwell in Moab, leave the cities and live in the rock, and be like the dove making her nest in the sides of the mouth of the pit.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:29
segments: We have heard the pride of Moab (he is exceedingly proud), his loftiness, and his pride, and his arrogance, and his elevated heart.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:30
segments: I know his wrath, says the LORD, [it is] not so; his boast, but they have not done so.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:31
segments: So I will wail for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab, and shall mourn for the men of Kirheres.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:32
segments: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for you with the weeping of Jazer. Your plants have gone over the sea; they reach to the sea of Jazer. A ravager has fallen on your summer fruits and on your grape crop.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:33
segments: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab. And I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses; none shall tread [the grapes] with shouting; [their] shouting [shall be] no shouting.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:34
segments: From the cry of Heshbon to Elealeh, and to Jahaz, they have uttered their voice, from Zoar to Horonaim, [like] a heifer three years old. For the waters of Nimrim also shall be deserted.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:35
segments: And, I will cause him who offers in the high places to cease in Moab, says the LORD, and him who burns incense to his gods.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:36
segments: Therefore my heart shall sound for Moab like flutes, and my heart shall sound like flutes for the men of Kirheres, because the riches [that] he has gotten have perished.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:37
segments: For every head [shall be] bald, and every beard clipped. On all the hands [shall be] cuttings, and on the loins sackcloth.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:38
segments: On all the housetops of Moab, and in its streets, there [is] weeping for all. For I have broken Moab like a vessel in which [is] no pleasure, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:39
segments: They shall howl, [saying], How is it broken down! How has Moab turned the back [with] shame! So Moab shall be a cause of scorn, and he shall be a terror to all those around him.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:40
segments: For so says the LORD: Behold, he shall fly like an eagle and shall spread his wings over Moab.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:41
segments: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized; and the mighty men's hearts in Moab shall be at that day like the heart of a woman in [her] pangs.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:42
segments: And Moab shall be destroyed from [being] a people, because he has magnified [himself] against the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:43
segments: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, [shall be] on you, O Moabite, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:44
segments: He who flees from the terror shall fall into the pit; and he who goes up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare. For I will bring on it, even on Moab, the year of their judgment, says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:45
segments: Those who fled stood powerless in the shadow of Heshbon, for a fire shall come out from Heshbon, and a flame out of the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab and the crown of the head of the sons of desolation.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:46
segments: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh perish; for your sons are taken away into exile, and your daughters into exile.

entries.title: Jeremiah 48:47
segments: But I will restore the prisoners of Moab in the latter days, says the LORD. So far [is] the judgment of Moab.
